subject: Finexa — Security evidence + next steps (SOC2, pen test, audit logs)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Finexa discovery recap + evidence requests (SOC2, pen test, audit logs)

Thanks again for the time today, Sarah — appreciate the thorough run-through of Finexa's use case and risk profile. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum toward a May/June procurement window: 

1) Recap (what we heard)
- Primary workloads: customer-facing semantic search + summarization on PII-subsetted data.
- Key concerns: SOC 2 attestation, recent penetration test results, audit log retention and export, and contractual DPA terms.
- Decision criteria: security/compliance (pass), latency < 300ms p50 for key flows, predictable unit cost.

2) Stakeholder mapping
- Please confirm the economic buyer for commercial terms (who signs SOW/PO).
- From our side I'll loop in Marissa (CS) for integration plan and Rishi for any security clarifications.

3) Evidence we can provide now (attached or via secure share)
- Redwood SOC 2 Type II (2025) — attached.
- Pen test executive summary — available; can share via secure link or SFTP if preferred.
- Audit log sample and retention policy — we'll provide a redacted sample log and retention table.

Action items / ask from you
- Confirm procurement timeline and required procurement documents (SOW, purchase order cadence).
- Confirm preferred secure transfer method for pen test (SFTP, secure Drive link, or vendor portal).
- Share name/email of economic buyer and legal/procurement contact to include in next convo.

I've attached the Redwood SOC2 report and a procurement checklist for your procurement team to review. If it's helpful, can we set a 30-minute procurement call next week (any morning PT) to review docs and timelines?

Best,

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers and next steps from our side: 

Stakeholders (internal)
- Sarah Lim — Security (me) — primary for technical evidence review
- Tom Davies — Procurement — handles PO/SOW and vendor onboarding
- Laura Chen — Legal — reviews DPA/contract redlines (cc'd on procurement thread separately)
- Economic buyer: Jonathan Meyers (VP Product) — will be engaged on price/commitment decisions

Evidence needs and preferred delivery
- SOC2 Type II ok to accept as pdf (thank you for the attachment).
- Pen test: we need the executive summary and a cover letter from the vendor; sensitive raw findings should be delivered via SFTP or secure Drive link with access controls.
- Audit logs: redacted sample (remove customer identifiers) and a CSV export showing retention policy applied to a 30-day window.

Procurement timeline
- Internal review window: 2 weeks after we receive the pen-test summary + DPA language.
- Target PO signed: by 30 June if evidence and contract terms look good.

I will coordinate with Tom and procurement@finexa.com to get a Procurement call on Thursday 14:00 ET. For the pen-test share, please upload to the Drive link you provided or let us know SFTP credentials.

I'll attach the internal vendor security checklist so you can see our acceptance criteria.

Thanks — I'll have Tom confirm availability for the procurement call.

Best,
Sarah Lim

Finexa
